original_question: Carl aduane a ne nigye ho ni cheese. Ɔdi abodoo da biara nnawɔtwe yi wɔ awiabere mu na ɔde di cheese a ɛyɛ abodoo biara. Na odi cheese ne nkosua a ɛyɛ omelet ma ɔnom anɔpa 3 wɔ nnawɔtwe mu, na ɔde omelet baako ho sen nea ɔdi ka paanoo baako. Ɔyɛɛ macaroni ne cheese aduane kɛseɛ a na ɔbɛtumi adi wɔ anadwo pii wɔ nnawɔtwe mu, na ɔde cheese 8 na ɛyɛɛ no. Nnuan a wɔatwa no dodoɔ ahe na ɔde dii ɛdwuma?
